description: Mild chlorotic yellowing on lower leaves — overwatering (monstera knowledge)
expected_assessment: Lower leaves show solid bright yellow discoloration likely related to chronic overwatering. The potting soil remains constantly soggy for extended periods, cutting off oxygen to roots. Upper canopy remains healthy, suggesting the issue is localized to the root zone.
actual_assessment: Lower leaves exhibit solid yellow discoloration, characteristic of prolonged soil moisture preventing root oxygen uptake. The upper canopy appears unaffected. Recommend withholding water until topsoil is dry and inspecting root health.

description: Severe wilting and limp stems — water deficit (monstera knowledge)
expected_assessment: The entire canopy droops significantly with stems losing structural rigidity. The potting soil has become completely bone dry throughout the entire root zone, causing loss of turgor pressure. Immediate deep watering is critical.
actual_assessment: Plant shows dramatic wilting with all leaves drooping downward and stems appearing shriveled due to complete root zone dryness. Turgor pressure has been lost throughout. Immediate thorough watering through the drainage holes is required.

description: Crispy brown leaf edges — low humidity (calathea knowledge)
expected_assessment: Leaf margins and tips show dry, brittle browning with characteristic yellow transition zone. The ambient indoor air is excessively dry, often due to active indoor heating or air conditioning. Interior leaf tissue remains green, indicating the damage is humidity-related.
actual_assessment: Brown crispy edges observed along leaf margins with a narrow yellow band separating damaged tissue from the healthy green center. Symptoms consistent with dry indoor air conditions. Increasing ambient humidity and moving the plant away from air conditioning is recommended.

description: Pale faded leaves with scorch marks — excess light (pothos knowledge)
expected_assessment: Upper leaves facing the window show bleached, pale yellowish-green coloration with dry papery brown scorch marks. Direct harsh afternoon sunlight is physically burning the delicate leaf tissue. Plant should be relocated to bright indirect light.
actual_assessment: Light-facing foliage appears washed out and faded with brown papery marks on the most exposed leaves. Damage pattern indicates excessive direct sunlight burning the leaf tissue. Moving the plant to a spot with diffused light will prevent further damage.

description: Soft mushy base — root rot (snake plant knowledge)
expected_assessment: Selected leaves show soft mushy base tissue changing from stiff green to dark brownish-yellow. This indicates the root system is decaying from persistent moisture. Immediate removal of affected tissue and repotting in dry well-draining mix is critical to prevent spreading.
actual_assessment: Base of affected leaves has become soft and water-soaked with dark brownish discoloration, indicating fungal rot from overwatering. The root system likely has similar decay. Removing damaged tissue and repotting in fast-draining soil is essential.
